name: web-travel-guide-case-study-cover-laptop-on-green-hill
title: Travel Guide case study cover: laptop and phone on a green hill with a huge white wordmark
whatItIs: A cover with a blue sky, a big white 'Travel Guide' wordmark where the 'G' holds a plane and pin, and a laptop and phone resting on a rounded green hill showing the tours website with arched destination cards.
whatItMeans: Open and aspirational; sky and hill make the devices feel outdoors.
techniques: Set devices in a simple landscape instead of a desk.
Hide a travel icon inside a letter.

vocabulary.definition: A symbol placed inside a letterform.
An image card with a rounded top.
